acceptance_criteria: cargo test -p jmap-filenode-types and clippy both exit 0. FileNode with role:None serializes "role":null.
close_reason: Removed skip_serializing_if from FileNode.role; updated doc-comment table and test to match spec §3.1 String|null type
description:
**What:** Remove #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")] from the role field on FileNode in crate-jmap-filenode-types/src/filenode.rs. The spec (draft-ietf-jmap-filenode-13 §3.1 line 486) types role as String|null — a required-nullable field that must appear as null in wire JSON when unset, same as parentId, blobId, shareWith, size, and type.

**Algorithm:**
1. In filenode.rs, remove #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")] from the role field.
2. Update the doc-comment nullable/optional table: move role from the Optional column to the Nullable (must appear as null) column.
3. Add test filenode_role_serializes_as_null: construct a FileNode with role: None, serialize with serde_json::to_string, assert the output contains "role":null.
4. Add test filenode_role_null_round_trips: deserialize JSON with "role": null → assert role is None; re-serialize → assert "role":null present.
5. Run cargo test -p jmap-filenode-types and cargo clippy -p jmap-filenode-types -- -D warnings.

**Defensive programming rules:**
- No unwrap in library code. Test assertions use .expect() with descriptive messages.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- Serializing FileNode with role: None produces JSON containing "role":null (not absent).
- Round-trip: JSON with "role":null → None → "role":null.
- Deserializing JSON with no role key also succeeds (Option default None).
- cargo test -p jmap-filenode-types exits 0. Clippy clean.
title: Fix FileNode.role must serialize as null not absent
